name: Listen HTTP Endpoint
description:
Use the listen endpoint to receive events whenever documents are modified. This endpoint follows the server-sent events protocol using the MIME type `text/event-stream`. The backend holds the connection open and streams events as they occur for any documents matching the GROQ query.
In most cases, you should use the [Live Content API](https://www.sanity.io/docs/http-reference/live) instead for new projects.
